input.summary: Add exclusive New York County forum to the existing New York governing law clause.
input.comment: [Playbook] New York law is already agreed, but the clause is silent on forum. We have added exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts in New York County, with a carve-out only for temporary injunctive relief, consistent with our preferred position.

ops.text: The state and federal courts located in New York County, New York shall have exclusive jurisdiction over the merits of any dispute arising out of or relating to this Agreement, and each Party irrevocably submits to such jurisdiction; provided that either Party may seek temporary injunctive relief in any other court of competent jurisdiction.
